_comment: Minimum PASS floors retained from the original matrix: no floor is lowered. Packages must equal pg-majors-packages.txt and every floor must be positive. Exclusions name exact tests/subtests and the majors on which they are outside the declared qualification scope; Go selects them BEFORE execution. Every failure or skip in an executed matrix package remains red. Historical v9 upgrade qualification requires its separate source-native producer and is not claimed by this matrix.
